audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Shiloh assembly, seven-tribe survey, and Benjamin allotment register, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Shiloh sanctuary, remaining seven tribes, Joshua's rebuke, three-man-per-tribe survey, written land description, lot casting before YHWH, Benjamin boundaries, and Benjamin city lists.

verses.restored: All congregation of children of Israel assembled at Shiloh, and they set up tent of meeting there. Land was subdued before them.

familiar.text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

modern.text: Then the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. And though the land was subdued before them,

original.text: וַיִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כָּל עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכִּ֥ינוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָאָ֥רֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: There remained among children of Israel seven tribes whose inheritance they had not divided.

familiar.text: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

modern.text: there were still seven tribes of Israel who had not yet received their inheritance.

original.text: וַיִּוָּֽתְרוּ֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא חָלְק֖וּ אֶת נַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם שִׁבְעָ֖ה שְׁבָטִֽים

verses.restored: Joshua said to children of Israel, How long will you be slack to go in to possess land YHWH Divine of your fathers gave you?

familiar.text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

modern.text: So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

original.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַד אָ֨נָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם מִתְרַפִּ֔ים לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Provide for yourselves three men for each tribe, and I will send them; they shall rise and walk through land and write it down according to their inheritance, and come to me.

familiar.text: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

modern.text: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me

original.text: הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑בֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵ֗ם וְיָקֻ֜מוּ וְיִֽתְהַלְּכ֥וּ בָאָ֛רֶץ וְיִכְתְּב֥וּ אוֹתָ֛הּ לְפִ֥י נַֽחֲלָתָ֖ם וְיָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי

verses.restored: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall stand in its territory on south, and house of Joseph shall stand in their territory on north.

familiar.text: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

modern.text: and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.

original.text: וְהִֽתְחַלְּק֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֑ים יְהוּדָ֞ה יַעֲמֹ֤ד עַל גְּבוּלוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב וּבֵ֥ית יוֹסֵ֛ף יַעַמְד֥וּ עַל גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִצָּפֽוֹן

verses.restored: You shall write land in seven portions and bring it to me here, and I will cast lot for you here before YHWH our Divine.

familiar.text: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

modern.text: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me, I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God.

original.text: וְאַתֶּ֞ם תִּכְתְּב֤וּ אֶת הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֔ים וַֽהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י הֵ֑נָּה וְיָרִ֨יתִי לָכֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: For Levites have no portion in your midst, because priesthood of YHWH is their inheritance; and Gad, Reuben, and half tribe of Manasseh received their inheritance across Jordan eastward, which Moses servant of YHWH gave them.

familiar.text: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

modern.text: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received the inheritance that Moses the servant of the LORD gave them beyond the Jordan to the east.”

original.text: כִּ֠י אֵֽין חֵ֤לֶק לַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי כְהֻנַּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה נַחֲלָת֑וֹ וְגָ֡ד וּרְאוּבֵ֡ן וַחֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֤בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: The men rose and went, and Joshua commanded those going to write land, saying, Go, walk through land, write it down, and return to me; here I will cast lot for you before YHWH at Shiloh.

familiar.text: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

modern.text: As the men got up to go out, Joshua commanded them to map out the land, saying, “Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.”

original.text: וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ אֶת הַהֹלְכִים֩ לִכְתֹּ֨ב אֶת הָאָ֜רֶץ לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ בָאָ֜רֶץ וְכִתְב֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וְשׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔י וּ֠פֹה אַשְׁלִ֨יךְ לָכֶ֥ם גּוֹרָ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּשִׁלֹֽה

verses.restored: The men went and passed through land, and wrote it by cities into seven portions in a scroll; they came to Joshua at camp at Shiloh.

familiar.text: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

modern.text: So the men departed and went throughout the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions. Then they returned with the document to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.

original.text: וַיֵּלְכ֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וַיִּכְתְּב֧וּהָ לֶֽעָרִ֛ים לְשִׁבְעָ֥ה חֲלָקִ֖ים עַל סֵ֑פֶר וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁלֹֽה

verses.restored: Joshua cast lot for them at Shiloh before YHWH, and there Joshua divided land to children of Israel according to their divisions.

familiar.text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

modern.text: And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh, where he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their divisions. Benjamin’s Inheritance

original.text: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֩ לָהֶ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ גּוֹרָ֛ל בְּשִׁלֹ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְחַלֶּק שָׁ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ אֶת הָאָ֛רֶץ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Lot of tribe of sons of Benjamin came up according to their clans; territory of their lot went out between sons of Judah and sons of Joseph.

familiar.text: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

modern.text: The first lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:

original.text: וַיַּ֗עַל גּוֹרַ֛ל מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיֵּצֵא֙ גְּב֣וּל גּֽוֹרָלָ֔ם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף

verses.restored: Their border on north side was from Jordan; border went up to shoulder of Jericho northward, went up through hill country westward, and its end was wilderness of Beth-aven.

familiar.text: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.

modern.text: On the north side their border began at the Jordan, went up past the northern slope of Jericho, headed west through the hill country, and came out at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

original.text: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֧ם הַגְּב֛וּל לִפְאַ֥ת צָפ֖וֹנָה מִן הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּבוּל֩ אֶל כֶּ֨תֶף יְרִיח֜וֹ מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְעָלָ֤ה בָהָר֙ יָ֔מָּה והיה תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו מִדְבַּ֖רָה בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן

verses.restored: Border passed from there to Luz, to shoulder of Luz southward, that is Bethel; border went down to Ataroth-addar by mountain south of Lower Beth-horon.

familiar.text: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.

modern.text: From there the border crossed over to the southern slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth-addar on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.

original.text: וְעָבַר֩ מִשָּׁ֨ם הַגְּב֜וּל ל֗וּזָה אֶל כֶּ֤תֶף ל֨וּזָה֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה הִ֖יא בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַל הָהָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר מִנֶּ֥גֶב לְבֵית חֹר֖וֹן תַּחְתּֽוֹן

verses.restored: Border was marked and turned on west side southward, from mountain before Beth-horon southward, and its end was at Kiriath-baal, that is Kiriath-jearim, city of sons of Judah. This was west side.

familiar.text: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

modern.text: On the west side the border curved southward from the hill facing Beth-horon on the south and came out at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the western side.

original.text: וְתָאַ֣ר הַגְּבוּל֩ וְנָסַ֨ב לִפְאַת יָ֜ם נֶ֗גְבָּה מִן הָהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י בֵית חֹרוֹן֮ נֶגְבָּה֒ והיה תֹֽצְאֹתָ֗יו אֶל קִרְיַת בַּ֨עַל֙ הִ֚יא קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים עִ֖יר בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה זֹ֖את פְּאַת יָֽם

verses.restored: South side was from edge of Kiriath-jearim; border went out westward and went out to spring of waters of Nephtoah.

familiar.text: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

modern.text: On the south side the border began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim and extended westward to the spring at the Waters of Nephtoah.

original.text: וּפְאַת נֶ֕גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֖ה קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבוּל֙ יָ֔מָּה וְיָצָ֕א אֶל מַעְיַ֖ן מֵ֥י נֶפְתּֽוֹחַ

verses.restored: Border went down to edge of mountain before Valley of son of Hinnom, which is in Valley of Rephaim northward; it went down Valley of Hinnom to shoulder of Jebusite southward and went down to En-rogel.

familiar.text: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,

modern.text: Then it went down to the foot of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim and ran down the Valley of Hinnom toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and downward to En-rogel.

original.text: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל קְצֵ֣ה הָהָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵי֙ גֵּ֣י בֶן הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַד֩ גֵּ֨י הִנֹּ֜ם אֶל כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה וְיָרַ֖ד עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל

verses.restored: It was marked northward and went out to En-shemesh, went out to Geliloth opposite ascent of Adummim, and went down to Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

familiar.text: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

modern.text: From there it curved northward and proceeded to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth facing the Ascent of Adummim, and continued down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

original.text: וְתָאַ֣ר מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְיָצָא֙ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְיָצָא֙ אֶל גְּלִיל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר נֹ֖כַח מַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וְיָרַ֕ד אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן רְאוּבֵֽן

verses.restored: It passed to shoulder before Arabah northward and went down to Arabah.

familiar.text: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

modern.text: Then it went on to the northern slope of Beth-arabah and went down into the valley.

original.text: וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל כֶּ֥תֶף מוּל הָֽעֲרָבָ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַ֖ד הָעֲרָבָֽתָה

verses.restored: Border passed to shoulder of Beth-hoglah northward, and border's end was at north bay of Salt Sea, at south end of Jordan. This was south border.

familiar.text: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

modern.text: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.

original.text: וְעָבַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל כֶּ֣תֶף בֵּית חָגְלָה֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ והיה תצאותיו הַגְּב֗וּל אֶל לְשׁ֤וֹן יָם הַמֶּ֨לַח֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה אֶל קְצֵ֥ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן נֶ֑גְבָּה זֶ֖ה גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב

verses.restored: Jordan bordered it on east side. This was inheritance of sons of Benjamin by its borders around, according to their clans.

familiar.text: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

modern.text: On the east side the border was the Jordan. These were the borders around the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.

original.text: וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן יִגְבֹּל אֹת֖וֹ לִפְאַת קֵ֑דְמָה זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ בְּנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֧ן לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֛יהָ סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Cities of tribe of sons of Benjamin according to their clans were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,

familiar.text: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

modern.text: These were the cities of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin: Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,

original.text: וְהָי֣וּ הֶֽעָרִ֗ים לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם יְרִיח֥וֹ וּבֵית חָגְלָ֖ה וְעֵ֥מֶק קְצִֽיץ

verses.restored: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

familiar.text: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

modern.text: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

original.text: וּבֵ֧ית הָֽעֲרָבָ֛ה וּצְמָרַ֖יִם וּבֵֽית אֵֽל

verses.restored: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

familiar.text: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

modern.text: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

original.text: וְהָעַוִּ֥ים וְהַפָּרָ֖ה וְעָפְרָֽה

verses.restored: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

familiar.text: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:

modern.text: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba—twelve cities, along with their villages.

original.text: וּכְפַ֧ר העמני וְהָֽעָפְנִ֖י וָגָ֑בַע עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן

verses.restored: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

familiar.text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

translation_notes: Shiloh becomes the central assembly site and the tent of meeting is established there, shifting the narrative from campaigns to sanctuary-based distribution.
The land being 'subdued' is a victor's administrative statement, not proof that no other communities remained or suffered.
Joshua's rebuke concerns delay in allocation, but land survey and lot-casting still operate within conquest assumptions.
The three-man-per-tribe survey creates written description by cities, showing early administrative textualization of land claims.
Lots are cast before YHWH at Shiloh, but ancient lot practice cannot override modern evidence, consent, land rights, or existing inhabitants.
Benjamin's allotment sits between Judah and Joseph and includes sites that will become politically and narratively important, including Bethel, Gibeon, Ramah, Mizpeh, Gibeah, and Jerusalem/Jebus.
Jerusalem is called Jebusite in the city list, preserving continuing non-Israelite identity inside an allotted space.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 18 to convert sacred lots, surveys, or ancient city lists into modern title claims or displacement tools. Center transparent public process, written accountability, and the text's own witness that allotment and actual inhabited reality are not the same thing.
